chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Jamil ibn Darrāj, from Abī 'Abdillāh عليه السلام.
That he disliked that one should perform sajdah upon paper on which there is writing.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: the Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.كِتَابَةٌ: writing or script present on the paper

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to perform sajdah on paper that has writing on it?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Imam Abī 'Abdillāh عليه السلام that performing sajdah on paper bearing writing is disliked. It pertains to the rulings of salat and the etiquette of the place of prostration.
